content:
maria: Heads-up — our org's quickstart CI started failing after switching to the service-account example. Local devs using personal keys pass, CI with OIDC service tokens returns 403 payment_required.

tom_ci: can you paste the minimal curl from CI?
maria: sure:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_SA_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"test"}'
# HTTP/1.1 403
# {"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing consent required for service tokens"}
```
lee_support: That's the paygate. We recently changed policy: non-interactive/service tokens require workspace billing consent to prevent accidental charges. User-scoped personal keys still work when the user has billing set up.
zara_sdk: Also noticed our Ruby and Node sample SDKs handled the 403 differently: Ruby returned the error immediately, Node retried by default which floods CI logs. We'll align behaviors and stop retrying on 4xx except 429/408.
maria: Okay — short-term workaround? Demo tomorrow.
lee_support: Options: 1) add billing contact/card to the workspace (best), 2) use a personal key in CI temporarily, 3) request a short whitelist from support if you DM tenant id.
tom_ci: We'll swap to a personal key for the demo and PR the quickstart README to document the billing step for service-account flows.
devex-bot: note: sdk/retry-behavior-fix queued -> canary (sha: 9d4e2f).
maria: Thanks all — I'll open the README PR and follow up with the tenant id to support for a whitelist if needed.
